en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large fortified hilltop complex with massive walls and several tall, slender minarets and a prominent central domed mosque, overlooking a sprawling city and open ground with scattered buildings and trees. The scene is labeled in cursive at the bottom left, and there is a printed website watermark near the lower right corner along with a small number in the lower right margin.
